definitions.gloss: leader; commander; one who leads a group
definitions.explanation: A person who leads and unites a group, army, or organization, directing its members toward a common goal. Emphasizes the authority and ability to keep a group under control and moving together.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|すぐ}れた{統率者|とうそつしゃ}だ。
{軍|ぐん}には{強|つよ}い{統率者|とうそつしゃ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: An army needs a strong commander.

examples.japanese: {混乱|こんらん}した{組織|そしき}をまとめるには、{信頼|しんらい}できる{統率者|とうそつしゃ}の{存在|そんざい}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: To pull a disorganized group together, the presence of a trustworthy leader is indispensable.

notes:
Composed of {統率|とうそつ} (leading, commanding) + {者|しゃ} (person). Refers to someone who leads and unifies a group, stressing the authority to keep it disciplined and moving together. More formal than everyday words for 'leader'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優|すぐ}れた{統率者|とうそつしゃ}: an excellent leader
- {軍|ぐん}の{統率者|とうそつしゃ}: the commander of an army
- {統率力|とうそつりょく}: leadership; ability to command

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導者|しどうしゃ}: leader; guide — leads by teaching and directing; less about discipline
- {指揮官|しきかん}: commander (military) — the technical term for one who commands troops
